blurb: Japan's imperial capital for over a thousand years, from 794 to 1868.

facts.h: The world's first novel was written here
facts.t: Murasaki Shikibu, a lady-in-waiting at the Heian court, wrote The Tale of Genji around 1000 to 1010. It is often called the first novel.
The US Secretary of War, Henry Stimson, who had visited Kyoto, had it struck off the list of targets for the atomic bomb in 1945 because of its cultural treasures.
Tokugawa Ieyasu built Nijō Castle in 1603 as his Kyoto residence. Its floors were made to chirp like nightingales when anyone walked on them.
